create_elastic_sampler: create an ElasticDistributedSampler instance with a dataset, num_replicas, rank, and start_index
test_elastic_sampler_iter: test the ElasticDistributedSampler __iter__ method to generate shuffled indices per epoch
test_elastic_sampler_len: test the ElasticDistributedSampler __len__ method to return the number of samples per replica
review_elastic_sampler_init: review the ElasticDistributedSampler __init__ to validate start_index bounds and compute num_samples
build_elastic_distributed_training: build an elastic distributed training pipeline using ElasticDistributedSampler with DistributedDataParallel
